newsitem.title: GERMANY: VEW sees 97 dividend at least matching 1996.
newsitem.headline: VEW sees 97 dividend at least matching 1996.

text.p: German utility group VEW AG said on Tuesday that it expected its dividend for 1997 to at least match 1996. The group raised its 1996 dividend payout by 50 pfennigs to 9.50 marks.
"Otherwise we wouldn't have raised the 1996 dividend figure," Fritz Ziegler, management board chairman of VEW, told the group's annual news conference.
Ziegler declined to give a definite earnings prognosis and said it was difficult to calculate whether or not the group would again register double-digit growth rates.
VEW said its net profit rose 12.5 percent in 1996 to 281 million marks on sales of 8.59 billion marks.

The group said that the harsh winter at the start of 1996 helped boost energy sales, but said that energy sales in the first quarter of 1997 were lower. VEW said it still hopes to lift group sales to nine billion marks in 1997 from 8.7 billion marks last year.
